visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a black t-shirt and a silver necklace, is centered in the frame against a minimalist gray studio background. He holds an open black gift box containing three makeup brushes, smiling warmly at the camera. (2) The camera transitions to close-up shots of the three brushes positioned against a solid black background, with the brand name "KAIBEAUTY" visible. The lighting is bright studio lighting, highlighting the fine texture of the bristles. (3) The man holds a single brush, demonstrating its softness by gently brushing it across his temple and cheek while gesturing with his other hand to emphasize its features. (4) A series of macro shots follow, focusing on the brush handles which feature metallic silver sections and the text "KAIBEAUTY K02". (5) A montage shows the brushes being used on a female model with black hair. The makeup artist applies eye shadow, blush, and contouring. The shots vary between close-ups of the model's face and extreme close-ups of the brush tips in action. (6) The male creator returns to the screen, holding the full brush set in its box, continuing his enthusiastic explanation. (7) The final scene displays the brush set box vertically with price information text on a dark background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with energetic, up-tempo electronic background music with a clear four-on-the-floor beat. A male voice begins speaking immediately in Mandarin with a bright, enthusiastic, and professional tone. (2) A subtle "whoosh" sound effect accompanies a fast visual transition to a product close-up. The BGM remains steady, providing a high-arousal energy floor for the narration. (3) A digital "pop" or bubble sound effect is heard as variety-show style text overlays appear. The speaker’s voice exhibits high pitch variability to maintain viewer engagement. (4) As the video demonstrates makeup application, the narration becomes more instructional but retains its energetic pace. Vocal delivery is perfectly synchronized with the rapid editing. (5) Transition sound effects like stingers or risers are used during scene cuts to emphasize different features of the brushes. (6) The audio concludes with a final musical flourish and a clean fade-out of the speaker's voice as the brand's price and logo are displayed.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature Inventory -> Practical Application Montage -> Price reveal & Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To introduce and promote the KAIBEAUTY Haute Smudge Brush Trio by showcasing its premium material construction and demonstrating its versatility for different makeup tasks including eyeshadow, contouring, and lip blending.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly introduces the brand name, showcases the product packaging, and concludes with pricing information.
